title: MAINT: refactor stringdtype internals to prep for bytestringdtype
body:
### PR summary
StringDType setup repeats boilerplote code in several spots. This refactors to consolidate repeated code paths in the dtype setup. The stringdtype-to-void cast loop is also largely duplicated with the stringdtype-to-bytes cast loop, so this consolidates the two loops.

It also sets up some re-usable machinery that bytestringdtype will also re-use. Merging this reduces the size of the diff for my [bytestringdtype branch](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/compare/main...ngoldbaum:numpy:bytestringdtype) by ~200 lines and deletes ~130 lines compared with `main`, net.

This is purely a refactor and should have no observable user-facing consequences.

#### AI Disclosure
An AI helped me identify the subset of my bytestringdtype branch that can be upstreamed as a stringdtype refactor.
